update.progress.complete: Download complete — launching the installer. The app will close in a few seconds.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: Language · Idioma
settings.language.description: "Auto" uses the operating system language. Manual changes require a restart to fully apply.
settings.theme.title: Visual theme
settings.theme.description: Dark or light. Light replaces backgrounds, cards and text while keeping accent colors. The FlightBook globe always uses satellite tiles.
settings.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.autostart.hint: The app launches automatically when you sign in.
settings.updates.title: Check updates at startup
settings.updates.hint: Looks for new app versions on GitHub when launching.
settings.tray.title: Minimize to tray on close
settings.tray.hint: Pressing X hides the app to the system tray. Right-click the icon → Quit to exit.
settings.simbrief.pilot_id_hint: In SimBrief: Account → Pilot ID. Without this, flights cannot be downloaded.
settings.simbrief.simconnect_hint: SimConnect (real flights): the watcher starts with the app and connects automatically when MSFS is running. Every recorded flight shows up in FlightBook.
settings.map.simbrief_lines.hint: Planned flights (cyan, dashed) on the FlightBook map.
settings.map.simconnect_lines.hint: Real recorded flights (green, solid) on the FlightBook map.
settings.backup.title: Create ZIP of the Community folder
settings.backup.hint: Creates a .zip with everything installed in Community. Useful before changing PC or reinstalling MSFS.
settings.storage.clear_caches.label: Clear caches
settings.storage.clear_caches.hint: Wipes SimConnect track caches, thumbnails and old queries. Does not touch your flights.
settings.storage.reset.label: Reset preferences
settings.storage.reset.hint: Returns to default values. Does NOT delete flights or the Community folder.
settings.tour.label: Replay the tour
settings.cloud.purge.title: Delete ALL cloud flights
settings.cloud.purge.hint: Irreversible. Resets the cloud schema to start clean. Does not touch your local flights.
settings.cloud.purge.confirm.title: Delete everything in cloud?
settings.cloud.purge.confirm.body: You will delete ALL flights and tracks in the cloud. This CANNOT be undone. Your local flights are safe. Continue?
settings.msfs_logbook.title: Import from Microsoft Flight Simulator
settings.msfs_logbook.hint: Auto-detects MSFS 2020 or MSFS 2024 and brings your flight history. Older entries may not include passengers / cargo / fuel.
settings.msfs_logbook.no_logbook: MSFS logbook not found. Is MSFS installed on this PC?
restart.title: Restart SimFleet
restart.body: The language was updated. To make all texts change (including modules loaded before the change), close and reopen SimFleet.
fb.title: FlightBook
fb.subtitle.detail: Flight detail — real route recorded every 10s.
fb.back_to_globe.tooltip: Return to the globe view with all flights
fb.empty.title: No flights logged yet
fb.empty.body: When you take off in MSFS with SimConnect active, the watcher will create an entry automatically.
fb.aircraft.title: Title
fb.delete.title: Delete flight?
fb.delete.body: This action cannot be undone. The flight, full track and all edits will be permanently removed.
fb.card.select_tooltip: Click to view this flight's actual track on the map
map.update_all.tooltip: Update all airports with pending updates
map.focus_tooltip: Click to focus this airport on the map
map.empty.no_packages: No packages detected yet. The app re-scans automatically when you reopen it — install something and come back.
addons.title: My installed addons
addons.subtitle: What you have in the Community folder right now.
addons.empty.title: No addons found
addons.empty.body: Make sure the Community folder is set in Settings → Folders, and re-scan.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Inventory summary and recent activity.
dashboard.empty.title: No packages detected yet.
dashboard.card.largest.empty: No package has a computed size.
downloads.empty.title: No downloads yet

pkg.uninstall_confirm.body: The folder will be removed in ALL detected Community folders (Steam, MS Store, MSFS 2024 if applicable) plus all associated database rows. This cannot be undone.
